title: D.S.Astro System: தசாநாதன் இருக்கும் இடத்தை லக்கினமாக பாவித்து பலன் எடுக்கும் முறை
author: T. ஜெய்சங்கர், மதுரை
systemCorePrinciples: 1. Dasa Lord's occupied sign is taken as the Temporary Lagna (தசா நாதன் இருக்கும் இடமே லக்னம்).
2. Dispositor of the Dasa Lord (house lord where Dasa Lord sits) is the Temporary Lagna Lord (தசா நாதனுக்கு வீடு கொடுத்தவர் யாரோ அவரே லக்னாதிபதி).
3. Sthana Balam (Planetary Strength) determines whether favorable or unfavorable results manifest.
4. 1-5-9 (Trikona) relationship operates on Uyir Karakatvam (Life signifiers - Marriage, Child, Lineage, Fame, Honor, Health).
5. Kendra (1-4-7-10) relationship operates on Porul Karakatvam (Material signifiers - House, Land, Vehicles, Career, Wealth).
6. 3-11 relationship brings victory only after strenuous effort and persistent struggles.
7. 6-8 relationship with Sthana Balam brings govt employment or sudden windfalls; without strength brings disease, debt, enemies, surgery, accidents.
8. 2-12 relationship brings marriage, cash influx or separation, expenditure and loss depending on planetary strength.
9. Parivarthanai (Exchange) introduces unexpected twists or disappointment in expected outcomes.
10. Rahu expands/amplifies matters; Ketu delays, restricts, or creates obstruction.
